raw_rows: Northstar Health | Epic-Inspired Synthetic EHR Demo
50 fully synthetic U.S. patients across common ambulatory, emergency, inpatient, clinical, revenue-cycle, and interoperability domains.
Open PATIENT_CHART and choose a Patient ID from cell B3. Excel recalculates the demographic banner and high-level chart metrics.
No real patient, provider, payer, address, phone, email, or account data is included. Not for diagnosis, care delivery, claims submission, or production integration.

The workbook is inspired by common U.S. EHR chart workflows and Epic-supported FHIR domains, but it is not an exact Epic Hyperspace replica, official Epic export, or proprietary Clarity/Caboodle schema.
Patient_ID is the common key. Encounter_ID connects clinical and billing events.
MM/DD/YYYY dates, U.S. addresses and phone formats, USD financials, U.S. race/ethnicity/language fields, ICD-10-CM, CPT/HCPCS, LOINC, CVX, payer/member/group attributes.
